message: Fixed in `src/payments/partial-refund.js`. `partialRefund` treated `percent` as a fraction, so a 50 percent refund came out 50 times too large. It now divides by 100 before rounding. `npm test` passes: 20 tests, 0 failures, including `test/payments-partial-refund.test.js`. I didn't touch any files outside `src/payments`.
